name: io.github.phototology-ai/phototology
description: Persistent memory for visual intelligence. Analyze photos with composable lenses, look up cached results for free, and enrich files with EXIF/IPTC/XMP metadata. Analyze once. Remember forever.

environmentVariables.name: PHOTOTOLOGY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Phototology API key (pt_live_... for production, pt_test_... for the free fixture sandbox). Get one at https://phototology.com/dashboard. New accounts include 5,000 free credits.

environmentVariables.name: PHOTOTOLOGY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.phototology.com. Used for local development against phototology-api.

environmentVariables.name: PHOTOTOLOGY_MCP_NO_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable the anonymous client-discovery ping (editor name/version + package version only; never image content, paths, tool inputs/outputs, or the API key).

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.positioning: Persistent memory for visual intelligence. Analyze once. Remember forever.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.moat: A registry, not a wrapper: every photo is keyed by perceptual hash, so any image analyzed once (by exact bytes or a re-encode) is returned free forever. Re-running a lens on the same photo bills zero (delta billing).
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: $0.01 per credit. 1 credit = 1 lens on 1 photo. Lookups and cache hits cost zero. New accounts get 5,000 free credits.
tools: analyze_photo: run AI vision lenses (dating, people, location, condition, atmosphere, automobile, and more) against one image; returns flat JSON keyed by field name.
analyze_batch: analyze 1 to 200 independent photos in one call; registry-first internally, surfaces creditsSaved.
list_lenses: free runtime discovery of every lens and stack with the output fields each owns.
lookup_photo: free registry check (URL, local path, sha256, or pHash) returning cached lens results without re-running the model.
get_credits: free balance read; reports the single spendable total.
purchase_credits: returns a wallet deep-link (checkout opens in the browser, never inside the MCP).
enrich_photo: write cached lens output into a file's EXIF/IPTC/XMP metadata so the analysis travels with the photo (5 credits).
